text: The plain, sober manner of its style all the more tellingly points up not only the horror of the case itself, which floundered on to the electrocution four years later of a German-born Bronx carpenter named Bruno Richard Hauptmann, but to the raree-show emotionalism and sensation-hunger of that era.
